headline: Cevdet Yılmaz Announces New Medium-Term Program
summary: Vice President Cevdet Yılmaz announced the new Medium-Term Program for 2027-2029. It updates the 2026 growth forecast to 3.3 percent and raises the year-end inflation forecast to 28.4 percent.
why: The Medium-Term Program sets Turkey's official macroeconomic path for growth, inflation and fiscal policy, which guides investor expectations for interest rates and the lira.
